title: Chapter 447 The Demon King Comes In Person
content:
Chapter 447 The Demon King Comes In Person

Everyone analyzed the current situation again.

It is not appropriate to fight the monsters head-on at present. Now is a good time for Dahuai Territory to cultivate high-end combat power.

When the battle outside is almost over, Dahuai Territory will sweep the nearby areas with thunder and lightning, and will definitely be able to lay a large foundation.

So, the second batch of top generals who entered the three-star secret realm, led by Ayub, stepped into the secret realm.

For safety reasons, more than 20 intermediate generals entered together.

They also wanted to try their luck and step into the opportunity of high-level generals.

In the secret realm, you only need to practice step by step, but there are still some monsters that grow very fast and need to be cleared, just as an experience for everyone.

After the battle of the Great Wall, Dahuai Territory began to recuperate, using the ancient battlefield to cultivate low-level generals, and then using the three-star secret realm to cultivate high-level generals.

Everything is so perfect. As long as you give Dahuai Territory time, you will definitely be able to give those empires outside a surprise.

But the idea was beautiful.

The news of the defeat of the demon clan soon reached the ears of the demon king.

Naris was furious. He never dreamed that he would be defeated in the place of Dahuai Domain.

After a period of recuperation, his injuries have almost recovered.

At the same time, the two demon kings who were injured under his hands have also recovered.

This time, the demon king intends to attack the Dahuai Domain with all his strength.

If the Dahuai Domain is allowed to grow, it will probably lose control soon.

The old empire has lost its vitality. It takes almost many years to produce a strongest king.

But the new place is full of vitality and the speed of cultivation is very fast.

The demon king does not want to wait any longer.

This time, he personally took action, leaving a demon king to guard the royal court, and another demon king Mikhail was responsible for reorganizing the army and attacking the Dahuai Domain again.

Both sides once again deployed their troops on the Great Wall of Steel.

This time, in addition to the demon king being the strongest king, the top combat power on the Dahuai Domain side has already occupied an absolute advantage.

Standing in the distance, the Demon King found 10 high-level warriors in the Great Sophora Domain.

He was greatly surprised!

The last time he fought with the strongest king of the Roland Empire, he suffered serious internal injuries, and now he can only be said to have barely recovered.

But if the battle is too fierce, it is easy for the old injury to relapse.

As the strongest king, he knows the limit of high-level warriors.

Even if there are 10 high-level warriors in the Great Sophora Domain, the Demon King is still 90% sure.

And Wang Shuo and others on the Great Wall are also solemn.

This is the real strongest king!

The top combat power on the entire continent.

The peak of martial arts that countless people dream of.

Fortunately, Gong Zheng and his team have defeated a demon beast at the strongest king level in the Three Star Secret Realm.

Although, that time, they racked their brains and tried their best, and finally suffered heavy losses.

But there is still the courage to fight the Demon King.

"Your Majesty, thank you for the three-star secret realm you gave me. How about we keep out of each other's way and form an alliance?"

Wang Shuo felt that as long as it dragged on, the Great Huai Territory would definitely become stronger, and maybe someone would be able to break through to the strongest king.

At that time, the battle would be more certain.

When Naris heard this, he almost vomited blood.

It would be better if he didn't mention this. Once he mentioned it, he felt that he was too stupid.

They actually cultivated such a group of ungrateful people.

"Very good, I still have the same conditions as before. If you join me, you can become my new demon king, or even the head of the demon king."

Maris said calmly, although he didn't hold any hope.
